name: @feitio/vanilla
description: Feitio's component behaviors in plain JavaScript, for any HTML: the timed Notice, and more to come.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts src/notice/index.ts --outdir dist --format esm --entry-naming [dir]/[name].[ext] --root src && bun run rename
scripts.rename: mv dist/index.js dist/feitio.js && mv dist/notice/index.js dist/notice.js && rmdir dist/notice
